title: JEE Main 2025 (Jan 22nd, Shift 2) - General Knowledge - Displacement Current
subject: General Knowledge

questions.q: A parallel plate capacitor of area A = 16 cm² and separation between the plates 10 cm, is charged by a DC current. Consider a hypothetical plane surface of area A' = 3.2 cm² inside the capacitor and parallel to the plates. At an instant, the current through the circuit is 6A. At the same instant the displacement current through A' is _____ mA.
